summary.name: Thunderbird
summary.one_liner: Thunderbird is a free, open source email application for managing messages, calendars, and contacts in one place.
use_cases: managing multiple email accounts in one app
organizing email with tags and filters
private email without ad-based data collection
reading email on mobile with an open-source app
summary.what_it_does: Thunderbird lets you access messages, calendars, and contacts in one app, with filtering and organization options. You can manage all accounts separately or view them in a unified inbox. It supports tags for finding messages quickly and is described as customizable in look and workflow, with extensibility. The page says it is funded by user donations, is open source, and is part of the Mozilla family. It also introduces Thunderbird Mobile for sending and receiving messages on mobile.
notable: Unified inbox or separate per-account management
Tags and filters for organizing messages
Open source and funded by user donations, not ads
caveats: Page does not specify which mobile platforms Thunderbird Mobile supports
Page does not state specific pricing details beyond being free and donation-funded
